messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning for a Q2 capacity spike. Thinking staggered buys across vendors (H100/H200) to avoid a single-wave customs hit and keep some loaners for staging. Need ETA, pricing tiers, loaner limits, and RMA constraints. Anyone? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

nguyen (vendor): We can split shipments. Suggest 40% immediate (ETA 6–8wks) + 60% deferred (10–14wks). Pricing: immediate at list, deferred at list -3%. If you commit to 6mo reserve we can do list -5% + priority RMA SLA. Loaners: available but capped to 10 units per PO. :handshake:

pradeep: Quick ops Q — loaner cap 10/unit ok? Need pre-ship serials for depot import docs. Also HS codes — heard H200 classification changed in FRA. @nguyen can you confirm HS and any invoice wording to reduce customs risk?

nguyen (vendor): HS historically 8471.50 but some EU customs are reclassifying. We'll include suggested invoice language and commodity descriptions to reduce reclassification risk. For RMA: DOA window 14 days; standard RMA repairs 30–60 days. Expedited RMA (NBO/air) available at +$400/unit. We can add insurance options.

linda: Staging question — can immediate batch route to AMS staging pool and deferred to US-west? Any cross-dock / temporary import costs?

nguyen (vendor): Cross-dock fees: AMS +€120/unit, US +$150/unit. If AWB marked as "temporary import for testing" (bonded entry) we can reduce one-time tax but need a bond and pre-approval. We can supply pre-filled manifests to speed entries.

morgan: Finance note — reserve (6mo) = ~5% lower unit cost but locks capital. Split/staggered buys keep flexibility but pay premium. Also add expected expedite RMA cost into TCO: DOA_rate * $400. What's our historical DOA?

alex: Past DOA ≈ 1.3% across vendors. For 200 units expect ~2–3 DOA. So we should only buy expedite for the immediate lot, not whole purchase.

pradeep: Can vendor provide CSV of serials pre-shipment (serial, SKU, S/N, model, fw) so depot can pre-create cases? That avoids inbound hold.

nguyen (vendor): Yes — pre-ship manifests with serials and firmware baseline included. For immediate batch we'll also include pre-printed RMA return labels for EU and US to speed swap. For deferred batches we can delay labels on request.

ops-bot: PO created: PO-4829 for 80 immediate units + 120 deferred units. Supplier: Nguyen Systems. Linked PR: PR-2026-78.

alex: Plan: proceed with immediate 80 units, deferred 120 units. Include 8 loaners to AMS (within 10-unit cap). Expedited RMA only on immediate lot. Action items: @nguyen send formal quote w/ AWB examples, pre-ship serial CSV, and invoice language; @morgan run reserve vs split buy calc w/ capex impact; @linda confirm AMS staging capacity for 8 loaners. :thumbsup:

nguyen (vendor): Will send quote + sample AWB + CSV by EOD tomorrow. Also attaching brief sample manifest snippet which we'll expand:```
SKU,SERIAL,MODEL,FW
H200-48G,HSN12345678,H200,1.02
H100-80G,HSN87654321,H100,0.99
```

alex: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll follow up once we have the formal quote and manifests.
